description:
The boss of Hedonia clad in a swimsuit.
Per Mustang's request, she has gone up to the surface to partake in a magazine photoshoot.
Her swimsuit is both striking and audacious, much like her own personality.

lines.text: What's wrong? Do you wanna help put some sunscreen on my back?
What do you think? Do you like this swimsuit?
Since we're at the beach anyway, it's okay to kick back and relax.
The way you're touching me... I don't know how much more I can take. Come here and loosen this strap.
If you'd like, I could wear this every day.
Here, come sit beside me. I can't go running over to you. After all, I have my dignity to maintain!

Are you taking a picture right now?
Or are you just... enjoying the show?
Hm... If you want to experience it firsthand, it might be better to come this way.
Next time, let's ditch the deadweight and hit the sea. Just the two of us. How's that sound?
I'm all for such a display of affection, even with everyone watching.
Indeed, the air up on the surface is so different from the stale air of the underworld.
Hedonia's boss in a swimsuit...? I can safely say this is a privilege given only to you, Mister.
Amassing influence requires formidable inner strength.

This investment will soon become a boon for our organization.
Of course, that includes you too, Mister.
Hmm, shall we use this power to party all through the night?

Hot summer beach and a gift from a handsome man.
What more could I ask for?
I give back as much as I get. That's a personal rule of mine, so expect a gift sometime soon.
This is lovely. I'll pay you back in my own way later, so you can look forward to that.
Thanks to you, I think this summer is going to be extra hot.
I'll see you tonight, Mister.
From now on, anyone who disturbs you will disappear without a trace.
If not me, who else could you possibly choose?
What's wrong, Mister?
Did you hear that, guys?
All right, let's have a look at your face.
Let's wipe them out.
Let's make quick work of this and head back, everyone.
Looks like it's time to return to our daily lives.
They're putting up a greater resistance than I thought.
So, this is how you're showing up, huh?
Don't rile me. I'll deal with you soon enough.
Mister, I'm ready.
What do you say we cool off?
Fire until your gun barrels melt!
How disappointing.
Look at all those bullet holes...
Is this all?
*Cough*...!
Damn it...
Argh...!

Tch... Don't you know who I am?
Attacking me is a death sentence.
Revenge is a dish best served cold.
